title: silicone popcorn popper
text: silicone popcorn popper. Works great!  I have to use the tiny kernel popping corn due to intestinal issues and I am always looking for an easy way to pop it.  This was great.  I used avocado oil (because it is a higher temp oil - less likely to burn) and then I sprinkled of olive oil onto to the popped corn and salt.  No burn on the silicone pot what so ever.  Because my kernels are so small, it only pops half of the volume of the silicone pot.  No problem for me.  I haven't tried sorgum or other kernels... but it looks like those could work too.  I think the trick is to be sure to use a high heat oil like avocado oil and smaller batches (meaning less time to pop).  I had very few un-popped kernels which is pretty hard with the tiny kernels.  Overall, I am happy with it so far.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
